text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: metrics-heartbeat-silence fired for prod-metrics-ingest (urgency: high). AlertID=PD-99214. Auto-page to SRE on-call.

maria: acked. i'm on call, pulling up dashboards. seeing heartbeat series gap starting ~1768604100, multiple scrape targets stopped reporting.

devon: same. prometheus scrape targets for exporters in eu-west-1 show 503s + connection refused. kubectl shows the prometheus-scrapejob has OOMKilled restarts on two replicas.

ashok: I can take infra side. looks like nodepool-autoscaler bumped some nodes then kubelet started failing TLS handshake? unclear. grabbing kubelet logs.

leah: tagging customer-impact. product-monitoring shows 8 customers with missing critical gauges for 15+ minutes. not yet on-call page to customer-ops but we should prepare notes.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) scale prometheus-scrapejob replicas to 4, 2) restart failing exporter pods (eu-west-1), 3) if scrape latency persists, fallback to minimal scrape config. I'll run commands.

devon: paste the commands you plan to run? want to run in parallel for EU/US.

maria: running:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy prometheus-scrapejob --replicas=4
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy prometheus-exporter-eu-west-1
```

maria: kicked scale + restart. replicas now 4 -> rollout in progress. watching pod readiness.

incidentbot: system: prometheus-scrapejob scaled from 2 to 4. rollout 2/4 ready (estimated 50s).

devon: i'm seeing exporter pods come up but failing liveness probe once, container logs show repeated TLS handshake errors with k8s API: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`.

ashok: hmm, that points to node certificate issue. did we rotate certs in eu-west earlier today? ops-deploy merge happened ~1768599000. rolling cert job might have misapplied. i'll check deploy logs.

leah: customer-impact update: 8 affected customers, 2 on higher-tier SLAs. severity: degraded metrics (dashboards stale), downstream alerting may have fired. recommend notifying customer-ops with an initial message: brief incident summary + ETA for fix ~15-30m.

maria: quick hotfix: switching scraper to use fallback scrape endpoint (no TLS) for exporters in eu-west until certroot is repaired. applying patch to prometheus configmap now.

maria: patch applied and configmap reloaded. `promtool` check OK. triggering prom reload via POST to /-/reload.

devon: good sign — some exporters resumed metrics within 30s. heartbeat series shows partial recovery for eu-west exporters.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-99214 acknowledged by maria.

ashok: found root cause: ops-deploy job replaced node CA symlink on a subset of eu-west nodes with incorrect file, kubelet rejected old serving certs. rolling nodes to restore CA symlink now.

leah: I'm drafting a short customer note for customer-ops: "We observed a metrics ingest gap in eu-west due to certificate rotation side-effect impacting exporters. We applied a fallback scrape config and are rolling nodes to restore TLS. Dashboards will refresh as exporters come back; estimated full recovery 20-40 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

maria: monitoring: latency SLO impact peaked at +220ms for scrapes, ingestion lag for log pipeline increased by ~12 minutes due to backpressure. will check kafka consumer lag.

devon: kafka-consumer-lag: topic metrics-ingest-backlog partition 3 shows lag ~120k. we've enabled temporary consumer scaling: `kubectl -n ingest scale deployment metrics-consumer --replicas=6`.

maria: scaling consumers. also enabled write_throttle=false for ingest controller to flush backlog faster (we'll watch disk IO).

incidentbot: system: metrics-consumer scaled to 6 replicas.

ashok: node rolls progressing, 3/5 eu-west nodes replaced and CA symlink corrected. kubelet connections re-establishing.

leah: customer-ops notified with initial message. awaiting ack.

maria: visibility: scrapes nominal for most targets now; heartbeat series backfilling started. prometheus TSDB compaction is busy but healthy.

devon: kafka lag decreasing to 60k -> 20k within 10m post-scale. good.

leah: update sent to affected customers with ETA change: full recovery expected within 25 minutes, will send another update on full resolution.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-99214 auto-resolve triggered (alert cleared).

maria: leaving a note for postmortem: root cause = ops-deploy cert rotation job accidentally overwrote CA symlink on subset of nodes; secondary factors = autoscaler churn + prom scrape config lacking non-TLS fallback. Action items: 1) patch ops-deploy to validate CA symlink, 2) add scraping fallback for critical exporters, 3) add alert that correlates exporter TLS failures across zones, 4) run disaster drill for cert rotation.

leah: filing postmortem doc now and assigning action items. thanks all. :clap:
